clauses.title: Termination
clauses.text: Either party may terminate for convenience with 90 days written notice.

clauses.title: Limitation of Liability
clauses.text: Vendor liability is unlimited for every category of damages.

rules.proposed_text: Either party may terminate for convenience with 30 days written notice.

rules.requirement: Liability must contain an express monetary cap.
rules.proposed_text: Aggregate liability will not exceed fees paid in the preceding 12 months.
